svg.title: agy-background-agent architecture
svg.desc: A live animated solution architecture showing AGY runtime signals entering a background assurance control plane, then producing lifecycle decisions, command timing guidance, and statusline telemetry.

g.text: A background assurance layer for every AGY turn
Autonomous strategist advising in-flight, guarding goals, and auditing termination.

g.data-notes: Fires after every agent turn to check execution telemetry and evaluate mid-turn advisor advice.
g.title: PostInvocation: mid-turn lifecycle event

g.data-notes: Invokes the terminal advisor gate before AGY completes its task.
g.title: Stop: finishing lifecycle event

g.data-notes: PreToolUse and PostToolUse measure execution latency and coach agent toward async patterns.
g.title: run_command: timing telemetry

g.data-notes: Append-only JSONL log analyzed for tool counts, repetitive error loops, and subagent dispatches.
g.title: transcript.jsonl: ground truth history

g.data-notes: Captures changed files, status, staged diff, and unstaged diff to verify real modifications.
g.title: Workspace & Git: diff evidence

g.data-notes: Normalizes stdin payloads, resolves module imports, and catches exceptions to fail open safely.
g.title: Hook entry: session-sage.py

g.data-notes: Coordinates mid-turn cadence, concurrency guards, background task grace periods, and sole final gate.
g.data-deps: mod_hook mod_evidence mod_guards mod_goals mod_advisor mod_triage mod_state
g.title: Lifecycle Coordinator: advisor.runner

g.data-notes: Extracts sanitized prompt, bounded agent-step history, tool counts, and git diffs for the strategist.
g.title: Evidence context: transcript and git

g.data-notes: Invokes background strategist with high reasoning effort to evaluate trajectory against goals.
g.title: Wise Advisor: Strategic AI Copilot

g.data-notes: Guards against race conditions, skips worker subagent sessions, and prevents early stop with active jobs.
g.title: Runtime guards: safety & race filters

g.data-notes: Tracks baseline pinned goals, in-flight revised goals, and secondary derived tasks across turns.
g.title: Goal Governance: pinned, revised, derived

g.data-notes: Confidence thresholding, category promotion/demotion, SHA-1 keyed deduplication, and policy routing.
g.title: Triage & Policies: confidence & dedup

g.data-notes: Atomic JSON persistence and flock file locks in /tmp to guarantee multi-process integrity.
g.title: Atomic session state and locks

g.data-notes: Injects one actionable advisor steer or watchout and keeps the agent working.
g.title: force_continue: course correction

g.data-notes: Emits [RECAP·cat] summary and allows clean exit only when prompt coverage and empirical evidence pass.
g.title: terminate: approved final recap

g.data-notes: Classifies shell latency into 5 performance buckets to prevent slow blocking commands.
g.title: Command timing guidance

g.data-notes: Renders model, active subagents, advisor counters, context burn against ceiling, and weekly quotas.
g.title: Real-time statusline telemetry
